name: RC-B10-0146/2025/REV1 – After § 56 – Am 12
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: 56a. Stresses the need to develop an effective EU level armaments policy that includes the establishment of a functioning and effective external trade dimension with the aim of supporting partners that face threats from aggressive authoritarian regimes and preventing arms deliveries to undemocratic aggressive regimes and those who make illegal use of them, as assessed by the relevant international human rights and humanitarian law, in line with the existing eight criteria of the EU Common Position on Arms Exports; stresses the need to overcome the very narrow and national interpretation of Article 346 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union in this respect;
